{{Quote|Ebe Endocott has come out of nowhere to challenge the best Podracers today. This confident Triffian boasts ''three'' semi-pro titles on Malastare.|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Beed]]|audio=EbeEndocottAnnounce.flac|<ref name="EIR">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']].</ref>}}
The '''Triffians''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] characterized by [[Hair/Legends|furry]] bodies and large, triangle-shaped appendages, called thermoregulator flaps, that protruded from the shoulders and helped regulate body temperature. Other physical characteristics exhibited by members of the species were three-fingered [[Limb/Legends|hands]], webbed feet, claws, and [[Color/Legends|colorful]] fur and skin.

Since integrating into [[Galactic community|galactic society]] by the latter days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Triffians were present on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. They were represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Eelen Li]] of the planet [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]]. The species boasted their own celebrity in the person of [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe E. Endocott]], a [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] known for a string of victories on the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and his personal panache. Endocott placed fourth in the [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|race]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], beating his rival, the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:EbeEEndocott-SWAnakinsSpeedway.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Triffians were covered in patches of differently colored fur.]]
Triffians were [[Hair/Legends|furry]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] whose stature stood them shorter than many other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. For instance, the Triffian [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe E. Endocott]] stood only 1.22 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="EIIG" /> The Triffian body could grow quite plump in some members, although the [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] remained thin. The torso and belly generally sported a thin coat of fur, either light-[[Color/Legends|colored]]<ref name="EE DB" /> or gray,<ref name="AS" /> that allowed details of the skin, such as [[Breast/Legends|nipples]] and scars, to show through. Dark, shaggy fur covered the back<ref name="EIIG" /> and hung from the long arms. The hands both terminated in three light-colored<ref name="EE DB" /> or brown fingers apiece, each sporting dark gray claws.<ref name="AS" /> The fur on the heels was dark in some Triffians,<ref name="FF POD1">{{FactFile|26|POD 1-2|Podracer Pilots}}.</ref> light in others. Members of the species stood on flat, webbed feet, each with three prominent toes and a fourth recessed on the outside edge. Each lower-limb digit sported a sharp, yellow claw. The feet were digitigrade, with ankles folded back toward the posterior. A long, thin tail, covered in dark fur but tipped in a lighter color, emerged from just above the buttocks.<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> The rump itself was colored brightly in blue or another shade.<ref name="EIIG" />

Two large, furred<ref name="EE DB" /> thermoregulator flaps extended from the shoulders<ref name="EIIG" /> and framed the round face like a mane. When fully erect, the flaps resembled large, dark-colored triangles with wisps of lighter hair at their uppermost vertices and below the snout; in this configuration, they allowed for dissipation of excess body heat.<ref name="EE DB" /> Bright-yellow<ref name="EIIG" /> or green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="EIWW" /> with irises and pupils of a darker shade flanked a short snout with long, angled nostrils.<ref name="EIIG" /> The face and snout were multicolored, with one hue of fur&mdash;such as blue<ref name="EIWW" /> or brown<ref name="R33">[[Star Wars (1998) 33|''Star Wars'' (1998) 33]].</ref>&mdash;for the [[Nose/Legends|nose]], between the eyes, and across the forehead and brow, and another&mdash;such as white<ref name="EIWW" /> or brown<ref name="R33" />&mdash;for the eye sockets, cheeks, and lips. In some specimens, another color such as yellow was intermixed as well, coloring the lips and eyelids, for example.<ref name="EIWW" />

The Triffian species was divided into two [[Gender/Legends|sexes]], male and female.<ref name="EE DB" /> Despite the sizable paunch that might extend so far forward as to overshadow the feet, Triffians were capable of great flexibility, bowing deeply at the waist, for instance.<ref name="EIIG" /> Indeed, many female Triffians found the rotund [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] Endocott physically attractive.<ref name="SWCTP" /> At least some male Triffians had deep voices in spite of their small size.<ref name="EIR" />

==Society and culture==
From ancient times, Triffians possessed artworks such as a [[Unidentified Triffian carving|stone carving]] of a Triffian figure.<ref name="FF COR12">{{FactFile|32|COR 11-12|Coruscant &ndash; Palpatine's Apartments}}</ref> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> members of the species were comfortable moving about [[Galactic community|galactic society]] either nearly nude<ref name="FF POD1" /><ref name="PRT">"[[Podracing Tales]]".</ref> or clothed with items such as dark pants,<ref name="EIR" /> jumpsuits,<ref name="EIRNSG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer Official Nintendo Player's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'' Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]</ref> belts, and [[Armor/Legends|body armor]]. Triffians were capable of utilizing standard [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] technology, such as [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons,<ref name="R33" /> and of operating more advanced machines, such as [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]].<ref name="EE DB" /> They had the capacity to learn to speak [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="PRT" /> At least one member of the species hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]].<ref name="FF POD1" />

==History==
[[File:VosTholmeDeadend-SW1998-33.jpg|thumb|right|upright|A Triffian guard attempted to prevent Jedi Knights Quinlan Vos and Tholme from entering the town Deadend on the planet Kiffex.]]
{{Quote|Congratulations, Ebe! Can I buy you a ruby bliel?&raquo;<br />&laquo;Thanks, Quadinaros! So, how much money did you win from Boles Roor?|translated=1|Podracers Ben Quadinaros and Ebe Endocott, after finishing the Boonta Eve Classic|<ref name="PRT" />}}
A stone carving dating to the species' earliest history attested to their long presence on the planet [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]].<ref name="FF COR12" /><ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> The world was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Eelen Li]], who served alongside her [[Human/Legends|Human]] colleague, Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. When Li learned of Palpatine's love for old artifacts, she retrieved the carving from a [[Unidentified Triffian museum|museum]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and presented it to him as a gift.<ref name="FF COR12" />

By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> a Triffian daredevil named Ebe E. Endocott<ref name="EE DB" /> had left his homeworld, Triffis, to race [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] on the planet [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]]. At the suggestion of his [[Ebe E. Endocott's personal clerk|personal clerk]], he switched to [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]], a more dangerous sport but one for which the potential winnings were much higher. Endocott quickly earned a name for himself by winning three straight [[Semipro Podracing Circuit|semi-professional]] Podracing tournaments on the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. Flushed with new fans<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>&mdash;many of them females who found his looks handsome<ref name="SWCTP" />&mdash;Endocott's ego ballooned, and he modified his [[JAK Racing]] [[J930 Dash-8 engine|J930 ''Dash''-8]] Podracer to place him high in the seat and therefore more visible to spectators. He also used his semi-pro winnings to purchase a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to transport himself to other races on worlds such as [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]] with panache.<ref name="EIRPOSG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> In 32 BBY, Endocott flew to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to participate in the professional leagues as an entrant in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. Nevertheless, he proved less skillful or lucky than he felt<ref name="EE DB" /> and came in fourth. Although not a win, Endocott was content to have bested the non-finisher [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]],<ref name="FF POD1" /> a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] Podracing darling of Malastare whom Endocott considered a washed-up boaster.<ref name="EE DB" /> Endocott continued his Podracing career after the Boonta, racing at least once more on Malastare.<ref name="EIIG" />

Two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, in [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Triffian (Kiffex)|Triffian]] helped defend the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Deadend]] on the planet [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] from outsiders under the command of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] criminal [[Gorto Zaga]], who had ordered the defenders to shoot [[Death/Legends|dead]] any who attempted to enter after dark<ref name="R33" /> so as to protect his illegal blaster importation business.<ref name="CSWE Gorto">{{CSWECite|III|366&ndash;367|Zaga, Gorto}}.</ref> When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], and their guide, the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], attempted to enter the walled town, the Triffian joined others in the band in opening fire on the outsiders. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Force jump/Legends|leapt]] over the walls and attacked the Triffian's group, overpowering them and securing entry for themselves and Grahrk. The Triffian guard survived the encounter.<ref name="R33" />

By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Triffian [[Ony Bobissia]] had become a regular at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] eatery [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]].<ref name="CSWE I 82">{{CSWECite|I|82|Bobissia, Ony}}</ref> Bobissia was standing outside the diner that year when the Human Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] consulted the diner's [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] owner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], about an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] against Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of Naboo.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:EndocottConcept-EpisodeIInsidersGuide.jpg|thumb|left|The final design of Triffian Ebe Endocott changed little from initial designs.]]
The Triffian Podracer pilot Ebe E. Endocott was created during preproduction of the film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which was first released in [[1999]]. Concept artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]] designed the character,<ref name="EE DB" /> and her sketches date back as early as [[1996]]. Whitlatch's ideas included both thin and plump versions of the character and feature prominent [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] that have not been visible in later Triffian illustrations,<ref name="EIIG" /> but her concepts otherwise match the final look of the species as it was realized in a detailed character maquette.<ref name="AoSWEI">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> Despite the elaborate preproduction designs of Endocott, the Triffian appears only as a low-resolution character, seated in the cockpit of his Podracer, in ''The Phantom Menace''.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}.</ref>

The maquette, naked to allow [[Industrial Light & Magic]] animators to use it for anatomical reference,<ref name="SWCTP" /> has since been used to represent the character in various sources.<ref name="EIIG" /><ref name="EE DB" /><ref name="FF POD1" /> The computer-generated model of Endocott was later reused for the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] to represent Ony Bobissia, a distant background character visible during a scene set on the planet Coruscant at Dex's Diner.<ref name="DD DB">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}.</ref>
